lookbackDays.title: Filed in the last (days)
lookbackDays.description: Read trade reports filed within this many days. Members have up to 45 days to report a trade, so a trade can be older than its filing.

members.title: Members
members.description: Names or last names, e.g. Pelosi, Taylor, Wasserman Schultz. Leave empty for every member.

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes, e.g. CA, TX, NY.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Only trades in these tickers, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, MSFT.

transactionTypes.title: Transaction types
transactionTypes.description: purchase, sale (includes partial sales) or exchange. Empty for all.

assetTypes.title: Asset type codes
assetTypes.description: The filing's own codes: ST stocks, OP options, EF ETFs, MF mutual funds, GS government securities, CS corporate bonds, CT crypto. Empty for all.

minAmount.title: Minimum amount ($)
minAmount.description: Skip trades whose reported range tops out below this. 50000 keeps $50,001 and larger.

includeSpouseAndJoint.title: Include spouse, joint and dependent trades
includeSpouseAndJoint.description: Off keeps only trades in the member's own name.

onlyNew.title: Only filings not returned before
onlyNew.description: On: each run returns only filings earlier runs (with the same filters) have not. For daily alerts. Off: every trade in the window.

includeScanned.title: List handwritten filings
includeScanned.description: Some members still file on paper; those are scanned images with no text. On: each is returned as a free row linking the PDF.

maxTrades.title: Max trades
maxTrades.description: Stop after this many trades. With onlyNew on, the next run picks up exactly where this one stopped, so nothing is skipped or billed twice.
